priority.description:
The priority for invalidation queue entries generated by the job.  When null, the priority will be that specified
in @invalidationQueueOptions(priority).  This field will be modified by the setPriority function to override the
default.  Avoid setting manually as that will not update the priority of already submitted invalidations.

disabled.description:
Indicates that the job is in the disabled state meaning that no queue entries will be processed for the job.
This should only be set manually when initially creating/starting the job.  To disable/enable a running job call
{@link disable}/{@link enable}.

maxConcurrency.description:
The maximum number of invalidation queue entries that will be processed simultaneously for a job.  If -1, no limit
is applied. This is enforced independently of {@link maxConcurrencyPerNode}.

maxConcurrencyPerNode.description:
The maximum number of invalidation queue entries that will be processed simultaneously for a job per node.  If -1,
no limit is applied.  This is enforced independently of {@link maxConcurrency}.

runAsUser.description:
If true, the appropriate functions (e.g. map/reduce in MapReduce and processBatch in BatchJob) will be run as the
user who started the job.  If false, they will be run as root.

nodePool.description:
When non-null, invalidation queue entries for the job will only be processed by servers with a matching
nodePool.  When null, invalidation queue entries for the job will only be processed by servers from default
nodePool.

skipIfRunning.description:
If true, attempts to start the job will be ignored if it is already running and no error will be thrown.  This is useful,
for instance, if a cron job starts a job and the job from a previous cron invocation may not have completed before the next
scheduled run.

If false, an error will be thrown if an attempt is made to start the job if it is already running.

numAutoRecoveryAttempts.description: Set to between 1 and 5 to enable auto recovery. See {@link invalidation-queues.c3doc Invalidation Queues} for detailed documentation.

propagateActionContext.description:
If true, the job will propagate {@link Action.Context}.
This should only be set manually when starting the job.

batchSize.description: The number of {@link ReliabilityRiskMlModel}s that will be validated per batch.

filterRelationsLambda.description:
An optional lambda, which when provided will be used to filter {@link ReliabilityAssetToRiskModelRelation}s.
The following fields of a {@link ReliabilityAssetToRiskModelRelation} are available for each relation and can be used in the function code:
- `to`, `from`, `start`, `end`, `status` and `route`
For example,
```py
myRelationFilter = "def filter_relations(asset_to_model_relations): return asset_to_model_relations[0]"
opts = options.make({"filterRelationsLambda": myRelationFilter})

Only the first asset to model relation resolved from the options will be scheduled through this job.
```

validationPeriod.description: Specify the {@link TimeRange} for which the models should be validated.

modelFilter.description:
Specify which {@link ReliabilityRiskMlModel}s to validate by passing in a {@link Filter}.
Only the models satisfying the filter condition will be validated.

If {@link ReliabilityOrchestrator.ReliabilityRisk.ModelValidationJobOptions#models} is also specified, that will take precedence

modelTrainingJobRun.description:
Instead of specifying the list of models to validate directly, specify an
{@link MlModel.Train.JobRun} that has successfully completed. The trained models
from this {@link MlModel.Train.JobRun} will then be validated.

If {@link ReliabilityOrchestrator.ReliabilityRisk.ModelValidationJobOptions#models}
and/or {@link ReliabilityOrchestrator.ReliabilityRisk.ModelValidationJobOptions#modelFilter} are also specified, those will take precedence.

assets.description:
All the {@link ReliabilityRiskMlModel}s deployed against these assets will be validated.

To filter any particular asset to model relations, use {@link ReliabilityOrchestrator.ReliabilityRisk.ModelValidationJobOptions#filterRelationsLambda}

assetFilter.description:
Specify {@link ReliabilityAsset}s for which you want validate {@link ReliabilityRiskMlModel}s.
By default, all the {@link ReliabilityRiskMlModel}s related to {@link ReliabilityAsset} via {@link ReliabilityAssetToRiskModelRelation}s will be validated.

To filter any particular {@link ReliabilityAssetToRiskModelRelation}, use {@link ReliabilityOrchestrator.ReliabilityRisk.ModelValidationJobOptions#filterRelationsLambda}
If {@link ReliabilityOrchestrator.ReliabilityRisk.ModelValidationJobOptions#assets} is also specified, that will take precedence.

title:
Use this type to configure a {@link ReliabilityOrchestrator.ReliabilityRisk.ModelValidationJob}

If multiple options are defined, the preference order between options is, i.e, :
models > modelFilter > modelTrainingJobRun > assets > assetFilter

The options are ultimately used to resolve {@link ReliabilityAssetToRiskModelRelation}s which will be validated.
name: ReliabilityOrchestrator.ReliabilityRisk.ModelValidationJobOptions
